summary:
"Who is this? More outsiders? How can this be?"
- Hippolyta about Zhalia Moon (Ladies' Choice)

"[Metz] took my mother to the outside world? She never told anyone. Why is she dressed like that?" (Hippolyta)

"It's... complicated." (Dante Vale when questioned about the wedding photo (Ladies' Choice)
